description: This file defines the Template class within the Opencart System Library namespace, responsible for loading and handling different template adaptors, as well as rendering templates with provided data.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Represents a Template handler that dynamically loads and interacts with specific template adaptors, allowing for path management and rendering of templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Template class by dynamically instantiating an adaptor class based on the provided adaptor name.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path associated with a namespace to the adaptor, facilitating template path management.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Calls the adaptor's render method to process a template file with the provided data and encoding.
